mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is active regardless of absolute rate levels.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% (UNRATE) indicates economic weakness and recession risk, causing investors to reduce equity exposure and generate negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand, driving corporate earnings expectations higher and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed their 12-month averages, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle contraction regime, declining industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening economic activity and reduced corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle contraction periods when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI index above 275 (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 275, or Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong residential construction activity and consumer confidence, which typically precedes positive equity market performance, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is active regardless of absolute housing start levels.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST is above its 12-month average, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth above 200,000 jobs (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 200,000, or Rank IC is negative over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reflects restrictive policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during monetary tightening cycles when FEDFUNDS is above 2.0%, or Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in this regime is below 0.03.
